name: Wireless & Signal Security
description: Skills related to off-device wireless and signal security assessment. Covers software-defined radio, wireless protocol analysis, cellular/telecom security, satellite communications, and spectrum/TEMPEST analysis. Distinct from HWSEC-RF which covers on-device RF hardware analysis.

categories.name: SDR & Signal Analysis
categories.description: Software-defined radio operation, signal capture, demodulation, protocol decoding, and signal processing. Foundational skills for all wireless security work.

categories.name: WiFi Security
categories.description: 802.11 protocol security assessment. Covers WPA/WPA2/WPA3 attacks, rogue AP detection, WiFi network reconnaissance, client attacks, and enterprise wireless security.

categories.name: Cellular & Telecom Security
categories.description: GSM, LTE, and 5G security assessment. Covers base station analysis, SIM security, SS7/Diameter protocol analysis, IMSI catching, and telecom infrastructure security.

categories.name: Satellite & Navigation Security
categories.description: Satellite communication security and GNSS/GPS security. Covers satellite signal analysis, spoofing, jamming detection, and space-ground link security.

categories.name: Protocol Analysis
categories.description: Wireless protocol reverse engineering and analysis. Covers proprietary protocol decoding, sub-GHz protocols (LoRa, Zigbee, Z-Wave), Bluetooth/BLE protocol analysis, and custom modulation schemes.

categories.name: Spectrum Analysis & TEMPEST
categories.description: RF spectrum analysis, emissions security (TEMPEST), electromagnetic emanation analysis, and shielding effectiveness evaluation.
